name: loaf-cli
description: Protocol kernel for the loaf feature-lifecycle workflow — single typed journal + in-memory projections.

scripts.lint: biome check --formatter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false src tests tsdown.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.format: biome format --write src tests tsdown.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.ga:check: bun run build && bun run ga:pack-smoke && bun run ga:consistency
